---
title: "Mitochondrial volume normalized to cell volume"
output: html_document
---

Supplementary analysis script for Fig 5B and S6 Fig. Computes per-cell mitochondrial
volume normalized to cell volume from [Cellpose](https://cellpose.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
segmentation masks and [MitoGraph](https://github.com/vianamp/MitoGraph) output.

Analysis steps:

1. From each Cellpose mask, extract area and major/minor axis lengths.
2. Estimate cell volume assuming a prolate ellipsoid geometry.
3. Compute MitoGraph mitochondrial volume / cell volume per cell →
   `analyses/output/mito_volume_per_cellvol.pdf`.
